provenance.snapshot: V15, July 1991 development source snapshot; final-release parity unverified

semantics.events: Preserves source declaration order, including TOP events whose positions may overlap following MTOP blocks; sort by s_m only for downstream lookup.
semantics.curves: Source index 0..7; sub1.asm adds one, then negates for left. Comment at line 796: 1 tight, 8 wide. Physical inverse-meter curvature remains unknown.
semantics.preview: Display aid only. Each distinct HUD pixel is a vertex; closed XY polyline length uniformly scaled to CLAP. Duplicate progress samples preserved separately. Independent elevation uses recovered inclination events with an explicit physical calibration and constant grade closure.
semantics.elevation: sub6.asm: VMSUP=5; degre accumulates signed displacement_cm shifted by 5-index. Flat stops inclination change, not inclination itself. Only cr1.asm supplies relief in this snapshot. See docs/ELEVATION.md for integration, scale and closure adaptations.
